# Vendored GDS packages

Built from [gds-ds](https://github.com/Open-Earth-Foundation/gds-ds) `v0.1.0`.

Storybook: https://open-earth-foundation.github.io/gds-ds/

Packages are not on a registry yet (`docs/releasing.md`). When
`@open-earth-foundation/gds-tokens` / `@open-earth-foundation/gds-react`
(or `@oef/*`) publish to GitHub Packages, drop this folder and install from
the registry instead.
